title: Key Value Pairs
description: Create a dictionary from keys and values in paired columns e.g. COLUMN_NAME_1, COLUMN_VALUE_1, COLUMN_NAME_2, COLUMN_VALUE_2 ...

parameters.name: input
parameters.description: Matched pairs of key and value columns.

parameters.name: skip_empty
parameters.description: Whether to skip empty keys or values when creating the dictionary.

parameters.name: if
parameters.description: Condition that determines whether the wrangle runs as a whole. Recipe variables may be referenced with `${variable}`.

parameters.name: where
parameters.description: Filter rows before applying the wrangle using SQL-like criteria, such as `column1 = 123 OR column2 = 'abc'`.

parameters.name: where_params
parameters.description: Values used with `where` for parameterized criteria. Uses SQLite placeholder syntax such as `?` or `:name`.

guidance:
Create a dictionary from keys and values in paired columns. ## Migrated examples #### Using Named Columns ##### Recipe ```yaml wrangles: - merge.key_value_pairs: input: Letter: Number output: Pairs ```
##### Input Sample | Letter | Number | | --- | --- | | A | 1 | | B | 2 | | C | 3 |
##### Output Sample | Pairs | | --- | | \{'A': 1\} | | \{'B': 2\} | | \{'C': 3\} |
#### Using a wildcard (*) ##### Recipe ```yaml # Using a Wildcard (*) wrangles: - merge.key_value_pairs: input: key*: value* output: Object ```
##### Input Sample | key 1 | key 2 | value 1 | value 2 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | A | One | a | First | | B | Two | b | Second | | C | three | c | Third |
##### Output Sample | Object | | --- | | \{'A': 'a', 'One': 'First'\} | | \{'B': 'b', 'Two': 'Second'\} | | \{'C': 'c', 'three': 'Third'\} |
